verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a pricing-page bullet listing "RBAC, SSO, Audit Logs" (medusa-docs-3). That implies role-based, least-privilege access control exists on some tier, but nothing shows those roles apply to API keys or tokens an agent could use. Missing for 10: documentation of issuing API keys or tokens with scoped permissions, evidence that RBAC applies to machine/agent credentials rather than human users, per-key scope or expiry controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
